name: MonarchPasskeyManager
title: PasskeyManager
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with a VStack of rows (MonarchIcon, Text, MonarchBadge, RelativeDateTimeFormatter in a TimelineView(.everyMinute)), MonarchButton, alert(_:isPresented:presenting:actions:message:) with a TextField for rename and Button(role: .destructive) for remove, MonarchInlineNotice, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState
summary: A person's passkeys, with when each was added and last used and a Synced badge, and Add a passkey, Rename and Remove behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: On an account security screen where people add, rename and remove the passkeys that sign them in.
whenNotToUse: To sign in with a passkey, use the sign-in form recipe with ASAuthorizationController. For devices that have accessed the account use MonarchDeviceList.
api: init(_ passkeys: [MonarchPasskey], title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, state: MonarchPasskeyManagerState = .ready, isRetrying: Bool = false, isSupported: Bool = true, isLastSignInMethod: Bool = false, now: Date? = nil, labels: MonarchPasskeyManagerLabels = MonarchPasskeyManagerLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onAdd: (@MainActor () async throws -> Void)? = nil, onRename: (@MainActor (String, String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil)
struct MonarchPasskey { init(id: String, name: String, created: Date? = nil, lastUsed: Date? = nil, isSynced: Bool = false, detail: String? = nil) }
enum MonarchPasskeyManagerState { case ready, loading, failed }

struct MonarchPasskeyManagerLabels { init(title:, description:, listLabel:, add:, rename:, renameLabel:, renameTitle:, nameField:, save:, remove:, removeLabel:, created:, lastUsed:, neverUsed:, synced:, confirmTitle:, confirmMessage:, lastMethodWarning:, confirmRemove:, cancel:, unsupported:, cancelled:, addFailed:, added:, removed:, renameFailed:, removeFailed:, loading:, emptyTitle:, emptyMessage:, errorTitle:) }

options.name: passkeys
options.description: The person's passkeys, shown in the order given.

options.name: description
options.description: Replaces the line under the title.

options.name: state
options.description: Loaded, loading or failed. A loaded empty list shows the empty state.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows the retry button busy in the failed state.

options.name: isSupported
options.description: Whether this device can create passkeys. When false, Add is disabled and a warning notice says why. Every supported iOS version can; pass false for managed devices where the app knows passkeys are blocked.

options.name: isLastSignInMethod
options.description: Passkeys are the person's only way to sign in, so removing the last one adds a warning to the confirmation.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for relative times. Without it they follow the clock, updated every minute.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Shows Try again in the failed state.

options.name: onAdd
options.description: Runs the app's passkey registration with ASAuthorizationController and the server. Shows Add a passkey. Throwing ASAuthorizationError.canceled or CancellationError shows a neutral note; another error shows its LocalizedError description or a built-in failure.

options.name: onRename
options.description: Saves a new name, given the id and the trimmed name. Shows Rename. Throwing shows a failure notice.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes a passkey after the confirmation. Shows Remove. Throwing shows a failure notice.

states.name: list
states.description: One row per passkey with its actions under it, separated by dividers.

states.name: synced
states.description: An info Synced badge after the name.

states.name: never used
states.description: "Never used" instead of the last-used time.

states.name: adding
states.description: Add a passkey shows its spinner.

states.name: cancelled
states.description: A neutral inline notice: "Passkey setup was cancelled. Nothing was changed."

states.name: failed action
states.description: A danger inline notice under the header, announced.

states.name: busy row
states.description: While a rename or removal runs, the row's Remove shows its spinner and the other row actions are disabled.

states.name: unsupported
states.description: Add is disabled and a warning notice explains that the device cannot create passkeys.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState; Add stays in the header.

states.name: failed
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: A MonarchCard with the subheading style title, a caption line in the muted text colour and a small primary Add button. Rows have the key symbol in the muted text colour, the name in the strong body style, a subtle info badge and caption lines in the muted text colour, then small ghost buttons. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Monarch does not create passkeys: on iOS the app runs ASAuthorizationController (with ASAuthorizationPlatformPublicKeyCredentialProvider) inside onAdd, because the relying party and the server challenge are the app's; Android does the same with CredentialManager. The web detects browser support from window.PublicKeyCredential; iOS 17 always supports passkeys, so isSupported is a parameter for apps that know they are blocked. The web renames in place with an inline editor; iOS asks for the name in a system alert with a text field (prompt-dialog on iOS) whose Save is disabled while the name is blank or unchanged. The confirmation is a system alert, which cannot stay open while the removal runs, so the pending state moves to the row and a failure appears as a notice in the card. The web's headingLevel and locale props have no equivalent (the title is a header; the SwiftUI locale environment is used). Several closures are optional (onRetry, onAdd, onRename, onRemove). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The title has the header trait.
Each passkey is one element whose label is its name and whose value is Synced, the detail and the times, built by a tested pure function.
The key symbol is decorative and hidden.
Rename and Remove are separate MonarchButtons with 44-point touch targets, named "Rename <name>" and "Remove <name>".
Rename and the removal confirmation are system alerts; the removal button has the destructive role.
Adding, removing and every failure are posted as announcements.
The unsupported state is said in words in a warning notice, not only by the disabled button.
edgeCases: The app updates passkeys after onAdd, onRename and onRemove return; the list does not change itself.
A name made only of spaces cannot be saved; the saved name is trimmed.
The last-method warning appears only when isLastSignInMethod is true and exactly one passkey is left.
Only one rename or removal runs at a time.

@State private var passkeys = [
    MonarchPasskey(
        id: "pk-1",
        name: "Work laptop",
        created: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_767_268_800),
        lastUsed: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_444_160),
        isSynced: true
    ),
    MonarchPasskey(
        id: "pk-2",
        name: "Security key",
        created: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_771_588_800)
    ),
]
